notes.title: Full Controller Support is Here!
notes.notes: [p]Great news, Journey Through the Undead now has full controller support.[/p][p]You can play the entire game with your favorite gamepad - aim, shoot, and explore the undead world seamlessly from your couch.[/p][p]We’ve put together a short gameplay video showing how smooth the controller experience feels:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="ISMLNHxQKJ4;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Give it a try and let us know how it feels with your controller of choice! Your feedback helps us keep improving.[/p]

notes.title: Partial Controller Support and Input Fixes
notes.notes: [p][b]Partial Controller Support and Input Fixes[/b][/p][p]We’ve added partial controller support to the game. You can now use a gamepad for movement and basic gameplay. Some menus and features may still require a mouse and keyboard, but we’re working on expanding controller support further.[/p][p]We also fixed an issue where players were unable to rebind the Right Mouse Button. It should now work properly in the input settings.[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback and support. Let us know how it feels if you give it a try.[/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update: Improved Physics-Based Throwing!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We've just pushed an update to the Journey Through the Undead demo, and it makes throwing stuff at zombies way more satisfying.

You could always grab and throw items before, but now the system has been refined for smoother physics, better accuracy, and more impactful hits. Whether it's a table, a chair, or whatever else you can grab, it now feels faster, and more fun to use in a fight.

Check out this short clip of me testing it out by hurling objects at some unfortunate undead:
[previewyoutube=q8bZqR0uw6M;full][/previewyoutube]

Give it a try in the updated demo and let us know how it feels!

Thanks for playing,
Dazzling Divine

notes.title: 🚨 Demo Updated – Polished Gameplay & Improvements!
notes.notes:
🚨 Demo Updated – Polished Gameplay & Improvements!

We’ve just updated the Journey Through the Undead demo with smoother gameplay, refined combat, and various fixes based on your valuable feedback.

🔧 What’s new:

- Improved stamina balance
- Smoother combat and movement
- More responsive controls
- General polish and bug fixes


This is not the final version of the game. We’re still improving it and your feedback is a huge help. Try the latest demo and let us know what you'd like to see improved!

notes.title: Get Your First Taste of the Action – Demo Out Now!
notes.notes:
🎉 The Demo is Now Live! 🎉

We’re excited to announce that the Journey Through the Undead demo is officially available to play!

🧟‍♂️ Blast through the first three missions as you fight for survival across a stunning, mutated world filled with relentless zombies.
🔫 Gear up with guns, melee weapons, and grenades to face the dangers lurking in a beautiful yet terrifying world.

This is just the beginning, we're thrilled to share this early slice of the game with you and hear your feedback!

👉 Play the Demo Now and Wishlist the Full Game!
Your feedback and support mean the world to us and help shape the final game.

Thank you so much for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to hear what you think!

Stay safe out there, survivors. 🧟🔥

- Dazzling Divine
